too few: remove the cap and run on highest volume
steady, target below P50: start at P50, step down at most 10% every 7 days to the target

findings.evidence: Spent $5,395 of a $9,000 budget (59.9%) in 30 days. The $11.00 caps, cut from $14.00 on 2026-10-02, sat below the real daily cost on 19 of 30 days (US | Broad) and 27 of 30 days (US | Lookalike 1% paying customers).
findings.fix: Raise the caps in one move: US | Broad to $12.00, US | Lookalike 1% paying customers to $13.63. Loosening a choked cap doesn't need steps. Check spend share again in 7 days.

findings.type: too few purchases for a ROAS goal
findings.evidence: 109 purchases in 30 days (25.4 a week), ROAS 4.44 on first-year plan value. Daily ROAS P10 1.37, P25 2.86, P50 4.22.
findings.fix: Leave on highest value. The user confirmed no ROAS goal is set now.

findings.evidence: 26 demo requests in 30 days (6.1 a week) at $28.32 each, under a $40.00 bid cap. Spent $736 of $1,800 (40.9%). 10 of 30 days with spend had a cost per request above the cap or no request at all.
findings.fix: Remove the cap. Cost per request ($28.32) is already under the $45.00 target, so the cap only limits volume.

findings.evidence: Daily budget raised from $150.00 to $200.00 on 2026-10-24 (update_campaign_budget).
findings.fix: No bid change before 2026-10-31, 7 days after the edit.

findings.evidence: Sign-ups split 233 United Kingdom and 95 Canada. With the user's paid rates (United Kingdom 20%, Canada 12%) the blended rate is 17.7%.
findings.fix: Canada is worth 0.68 of an average sign-up: bid 30% less there. United Kingdom differs by less than 20%, so no rule.

ads_manager.what: Value rule for Prospecting | Sign-ups | UK and Canada: bid 30% less for Canada
ads_manager.steps: Attach it on the same day as the first cap change, so the ad set restarts learning once. Advertising settings, then Value rules, then create a rule set with one rule: Location is Canada, bid 30% less. Attach it to the campaign. If the option isn't offered for this campaign, keep the plan for the next rebuild. Check cost per sign-up 14 days after attaching it: Meta warns value rules can raise it.
